title: No orders: cash in USDC, ETH and SOL trend shorts kept
journal:
Self-review: the book is $541.4 (0.99x of $547.6). No memecoin positions; 93% in USDC. The two 55/20 breakout shorts (ETH 2x, SOL 2x) are slightly underwater (-$0.5 total) and keep their exits at the 20-day highs. The brain stayed defensive (SOL and BTC below their 20-day averages, 1 of 18 large memecoins above theirs) and bought nothing, which is right. The news radar saw one bearish item (US spot bitcoin ETF outflows of $643M) without price confirmation and did not trade, also right.

Rule change today: a watchlist token that is still falling (more than -5% over 6 hours) is no longer treated as a healthy pullback. This comes from the trading desk's GTA6 re-entry, which was stopped out at -30%.

Devil's advocate: holding so much cash means missing a sudden rebound; the trend shorts would lose then, but each risks only 1% of the book.
